Name: Dottie's Delightful Characters
Author: odetteeternia
Description:
[size=5][center]Hello and Welcome![/center][/size][size=2]I consider this mod to be a private treasure to me. It is a redesign of the marriage candidate as my own characters. Since 2022, I have dreamt of playing with my own characters in the game. It was in 2024 when I decided to make my dream a reality. For almost the entirety of 2025, I have spent my pastime drawing sprite sheets of each character. Since I have not explored this skill before, it was a slow beginning, but now it is complete.

[/size][size=4]Requirements:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999?tab=description]Portraiture[/url][/size]
[/list]
[size=4]Instructions:[/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=2]Unzip the primary folder.[/size]
[*][size=2]Download Portraiture, SMAPI, and Content Patcher.[/size]
[*][size=2]Create Portraiture folder inside the mods folder. [/size]
[*][size=2]Create Portraits folder inside Portraiture folder.[/size]
[*][size=2]Place the portrait inside the Portraits folder.[/size]
[*][size=2]Place the '[CP] Dottie's Delightful Characters' folder into the mods folder.[/size]
[/list]
[size=4]This mod changes the following:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]Marriage Candidate Sprites[/size]
[*][size=2]Marriage Candidate Portraits[/size]
[/list]
[center][size=5]Renaming Characters[/size][/center][size=2]Optionally, you can rename the candidates' names to suit my characters better. I would recommend using [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/82887233]ApollyonSV[/url][size=2]'s [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9271]Ultimate Villager Manager[/url][size=2] to change it.[/size]
[size=4]
The characters are as follows:﻿[/size]
[list]
[*]Abigail as Vanessa
[*]Alex as Leo
[*]Elliott as Cedric
[*]Emily as Myra
[*]Haley as Diana
[*]Harvey as Charles
[*]Leah as Lilith
[*]Maru as Brenda
[*]Penny as Daisy
[*]Sam as Luke
[*]Sebastian as Nathan
[*]Shane as Nakht
[/list][center]
Thank you for reading up to this point! Please inform me of any errors so that I can correct them. Farewell![/center]
